info.title: NETGEAR GS108Tv2 web UI
info.description: Unofficial description of the NETGEAR GS108Tv2 ProSAFE web UI as an HTTP contract. The switch has no JSON API: GET returns page HTML, and POST submits the page's own form back to the same path. POSTs are read-modify-write, so fetch the page, change the fields you care about, and submit everything else as rendered. Page paths come from the switch's own menu JavaScript; form bodies have not been captured yet. Run `discover` against your device, then regenerate, to fill in the field schemas. Operations marked destructive reboot the switch, restore factory defaults, or write firmware; call them deliberately. Not affiliated with NETGEAR.

post.description: Sets the session cookie. On success the device returns 302 to /base/web_main.html; on failure it returns the login page with err_flag=1.

cookieAuth.name: Cookie
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie issued by POST /base/main_login.html. The client stores it automatically; its name is chosen by the device.
